summary: Three documented Bitcoin circular economies operating in Ghana as of 2025-2026. All data sourced from their public websites, social media, and published media coverage.

entries.name: Bitcoin Dua
entries.description: One of the clearest Bitcoin Beach-style circular economies in West Africa. Founded by Mawufemor Kofi Folivi, a 20+ year community organizer in Agbozume and Managing Director of the Talent Foundation. Started after Kofi attended the Africa Bitcoin Conference in December 2022, inspired in part by Bitcoin Ekasi in South Africa.
facts: Education center with 20+ laptops teaching Bitcoin and coding
Approximately 30 local merchants onboarded to accept Lightning payments
Youth sports programs rewarding players in sats (using Fedi)
$50,000 grant from Block (Jack Dorsey) in late 2024

press.label: Bitcoin Dua: Empowering Youth Through Bitcoin and STEM

entries.name: Bitfiasi Initiative
entries.founder: Gideon Kombat and Sena K. Ami
entries.description: Building a Bitcoin circular economy in Dodowa under the hashtag #DodowaGoesBitcoin. Founded in 2024 by Gideon Kombat (@FinallyGidkom) and Sena K. Ami (@SenaKAmi). A light node of Mi Primer Bitcoin, the international Bitcoin education network. Operates on Blink and has merchants listed on BTCMap.
facts: Active merchant onboarding in Dodowa market area
Light node of Mi Primer Bitcoin international education network

entries.name: Bitcoin Aves
entries.description: Bitcoin education and circular economy project in Akatsi with a distinctive approach: pairing Bitcoin literacy with youth empowerment and food production and processing programs. A light node of Mi Primer Bitcoin. Listed by Geyser alongside Bitcoin Beach and Bitcoin Ekasi as one of the top Bitcoin circular economy projects globally.
facts: Bitcoin education focused on African youth
Food production and processing programs run alongside financial literacy
Light node of Mi Primer Bitcoin education network
Part of the FBCE (Foundation for Bitcoin Circular Economies) global network
Active since 2025, Geyser fund campaign running
